questions.question: What should I do about mosquitoes at night?
answer_facts: Every bedroom has window screens and a plug-in repellent; refills are in the kitchen drawer.
Mosquitoes are worst at dusk and during the monsoon.
Mosquito nets are available on request for any bed.
